name: getMeterPerMapUnit
description: 单位换算，把米|度|千米|英寸|英尺换算成米。
usage:
// 浏览器
<script type="text/javascript" src="https://iclient.supermap.io/dist/mapboxgl/iclient-mapboxgl.js"></script>
<script>
  const result = mapboxgl.supermap.getMeterPerMapUnit(mapUnit);

</script>

// ES6 Import
import { getMeterPerMapUnit } from '@supermapgis/iclient-mapboxgl';

const result = getMeterPerMapUnit(mapUnit);

name: getWrapNum
description: 获取该坐标系的经纬度范围的经度或纬度。

params.description: 是否获取经度或纬度的最大值。
params.name: includeMax

params.description: 是否获取经度或纬度的最小值。
params.name: includeMin

usage:
// 浏览器
<script type="text/javascript" src="https://iclient.supermap.io/dist/mapboxgl/iclient-mapboxgl.js"></script>
<script>
  const result = mapboxgl.supermap.getWrapNum(x, includeMax, includeMin, range);

</script>

// ES6 Import
import { getWrapNum } from '@supermapgis/iclient-mapboxgl';

const result = getWrapNum(x, includeMax, includeMin, range);

name: scalesToResolutions
description: 通过比例尺数组计算分辨率数组，没有传入比例尺数组时通过地图范围与地图最大级别进行计算。
usage:
// 浏览器
<script type="text/javascript" src="https://iclient.supermap.io/dist/mapboxgl/iclient-mapboxgl.js"></script>
<script>
  const result = mapboxgl.supermap.scalesToResolutions(scales, bounds, dpi, mapUnit);

</script>

// ES6 Import
import { scalesToResolutions } from '@supermapgis/iclient-mapboxgl';

const result = scalesToResolutions(scales, bounds, dpi, mapUnit);
